meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会去检索 cmem.ai 上的持久记忆——里面有从你过去各 agent 会话合成的带时间戳记录。它先做宽泛关键词搜索，再用更具体的词收窄，最后用通俗语言作答，不把原始输出直接甩给你。
howto.when: 当你说「搜索记忆」「你还记得 X 吗」「查一下 claude-mem」等，或想了解某项目、决定、文件的以往会话上下文时会触发。

say.text: 搜一下记忆里关于这个项目的记录
上个会话我们做了什么？
你还记得我们改过哪个配置文件吗
say.note: 再用更具体的词收窄查找

howto.what_en: Claude searches your Claude-Mem memory on cmem.ai — timestamped observations from past sessions across your agents. It runs broad keyword passes, narrows with specific terms, then answers in plain language instead of dumping raw output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search memory, what Claude remembers about X, or check claude-mem, or want prior-session context on a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search memory for notes about this project
What did we do last session?
Do you remember which config file we changed?
